instruction: Use the opened Autodesk Revit environment and its automation interfaces to export the completed model to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc as IFC4. For this task, use `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe` as the Revit entry point for this automation. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside Revit. The current model is a plain two-level laboratory block. The design lead wants clearer Lab and Prep zones on both floors and a modest sloped roof so the building reads as a small campus outbuilding rather than a flat box.
